title: 2.3.12 Predict the Fall-Through
description: Write a three-case switch where the first case deliberately has no break, predict the output, then run it and check. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: book 2.3.3 — Concepts in Practice: Tracing fall-through, Q1

steps.title: Write a three-case switch
steps.instructions: Create a variable x set to a value that matches your first case. Write a switch with three case labels in a row (for example 1, 2, 3). Leave the first case WITHOUT a break on purpose. Give the second and third cases a break each.

steps.title: Predict, then run
steps.instructions: Before running, write a comment predicting exactly which console.log lines will print. Then run the file and compare your prediction to the real output.

requirements.title: three case labels present
requirements.description: Code contains at least three case labels in sequence

requirements.title: break present
requirements.description: Code contains at least one break statement
